summary: Resolved the proposal-pause question by tracing the measured size. The in-memory accounting increases on append, resets on replacement/truncation, clears on snapshot restore, and decreases by exactly the applied slice size when entries move below the marker, so it is a live measure rather than a monotone counter; applied entries leave the measured region through application progress, not through admitting new proposals, and follower-reported sizes are discarded after the gc window. Marked the investigation explained with defect_claim refuted, answered the gap as resolved, and recorded the size-accounting behavior, keeping the backlog-driven pause length and state-machine dependence as stated limits. No execution was run.
